functions.name: has_nexora_permission
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.has_nexora_permission(p_permission_key text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select (select auth.jwt()->>'aal') = 'aal2'
    and (
      private.is_nexora_super_admin()
      or exists (
        select 1 from public.admin_staff s
        join public.profiles p on p.id=s.user_id
        join public.admin_permission_grants g on g.admin_user_id=s.user_id
        where s.user_id=(select auth.uid())
          and s.admin_level='assistant_admin' and s.is_active=true
          and p.role='admin' and p.account_status='active'
          and g.permission_key=p_permission_key and g.is_allowed=true
      )
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_nexora_active_admin_staff()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select (select auth.jwt()->>'aal') = 'aal2'
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.admin_staff s
      join public.profiles p on p.id = s.user_id
      where s.user_id = (select auth.uid())
        and s.is_active = true
        and p.role = 'admin'
        and p.account_status = 'active'
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.protect_profile_role_and_status()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ begin if auth.uid() is not null and auth.uid()=old.id and (new.role is distinct from old.role or new.account_status is distinct from old.account_status) then raise exception 'Role and account status are protected fields'; end if; return new; end; $function$
